title: Katalog źródeł danych o lokalizacjach AED w Polsce
method: Each source fetched live on the 'checked' date; row_count, schema (with fill rate 'filled' = non-empty/total) and sample_rows computed from the downloaded file. Fields prefixed '_' are derived from geometry/structure, not source columns.

datasets.license_note: Attribution '© OpenStreetMap contributors' + share-alike for derived databases.
datasets.access_method: Direct download, no auth; also Overpass API
datasets.update_frequency: Continuous (built from live OSM; HTTP cache 1h)
